description: This file is a C++ source file that implements a main function to set up and register a default storage service using Android's binder IPC mechanism. It creates a Storage service instance, registers it with the service manager, and joins the thread pool.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes the binder thread pool, creates a Storage service instance, registers it as a lazy service with a specific name, and then joins the thread pool. The function returns EXIT_FAILURE, indicating it should not normally reach the end.
